item.title: LIVE: ABC News Live
item.summary: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: WATCH: Search for American journalist kidnapped in Iraq
item.summary: A source says the FBI is now involved in the search for veteran American journalist Shelly Kittleson.

item.title: Trump replacing Pam Bondi as attorney general, Todd Blanche to step in
item.summary: President Trump has announced that Pam Bondi is being ousted as his attorney general, and that Todd Blanche will serve as acting attorney general.

item.title: Suspect arrested in killing of 7-month-old baby shot in stroller, police say
item.summary: A 7-month-old baby girl in a stroller was shot and killed when two people on a moped drove past a busy street corner and one of them opened fire, authorities said.

item.title: WATCH: KitKat launches tracker after chocolate heist
item.summary: Nestlé, the maker of KitKat, has launched a tracker in an attempt to find the 12 tons of stolen chocolate.

item.title: WATCH: Artemis II crew crosses boundary into space
item.summary: The four-person crew of the Artemis II mission has crossed the boundary into space after launching from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

item.title: WATCH: Historic Artemis II mission to the moon manned with 4 astronauts
item.summary: NASA teams cheered and crowds at Kennedy Space Center clamored to view the launch as the astronauts embarked on their voyage.

item.title: WATCH: The science behind how astronauts’ bodies respond in space
item.summary: ABC News’ Linsey Davis spoke with UCLA director of space medicine Dr. Haig Aintablian on how astronauts are preparing for their trip to space ahead of the Artemis II launch.

item.title: WATCH: Trump's deputy attorney general and former personal attorney Todd Blanche will serve as acting Attorney General, the president said.
item.summary: Trump's deputy attorney general and former personal attorney Todd Blanche will serve as acting Attorney General, the president said.

item.title: WATCH: New Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche has a track record of loyalty to President Trump — but so did Pam Bondi, ABC News' Alex Mallin reports.
item.summary: New Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche has a track record of loyalty to President Trump — but so did Pam Bondi, ABC News' Alex Mallin reports.
